Definition: Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Bela = "destruction"; n pr m; 1) a king of Edom; 2) first son of Benjamin; 3) a son of Ahaz, a Reubenite; n pr loc; 4) one of the five cities of the plain which was spared at the intercession of Lot, and received the name of Zoar
